records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production Godot 2D restaurant exterior sprite. Input image 1 is the user Chinese 焰请八方酒楼 design reference; image 2 is the old runtime building and defines ONLY camera, pixel-art style and footprint. Transform the main Chinese restaurant in image 1 into one isolated game sprite matching the front-facing orthographic slightly overhead camera of image 2, NO visible deep right wall or isometric diamond foundation. Preserve two stories, green curved tile roofs with flame-shaped gold finials, warm dark red wood, balcony, red lanterns, fire motifs, chef-hat crest, a central unobstructed ground-floor door, small cooking stove and wine jars near sides. Exact main sign text 焰请八方酒楼. Crisp deliberate pixel art, readable chunky clusters and clean dark outlines, warm restrained palette; simplify tiny details for map readability. Entire building centered square canvas with transparent padding on all sides, complete roof and base, entrance at bottom horizontal center. Minimal narrow straight stone threshold, no large platform, no outdoor furniture blocking entrance. Remove every surrounding annotation, arrows, dimensions, extra views, mascot, swatches and page background. One complete building ONLY, no people, no scenery, no drop shadow, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Keep visual height-to-width ratio around 0.9, consistent with the old runtime facade. Do not output a concept sheet.
records.reference_name: 焰请八方酒楼概念设计图.png
